title: Tunes played at the New York restaurant

blocks.x: Never, don't remember any of those. There's quite a number of other tunes that they were playing. Yeah, well, I think that they're the composition of some of those. Oceana Roll, was one of them. Oh, yeah.
They played that. Do you remember any popular tunes that were used?

Well, another tune in those days was, uh, uh, they could get some real harmony on, was, uh, Fiddle Up, on your violin. No. Lay right on it, rest your chin upon it. Oh, man, that was real music. They really, they knocked that one off, too. Wonderly. Uh, the band you heard is Rides and Webbers. Do you recall an instrumentation? Well, I can recall, it was typically a Dixieland jazz instrumentation. It was a trombone and a trumpet and a clarinet, and, of course, the band, and, of course, the band, a bass fiddle, and, uh, I think it was a tenor sax and a piano. Wow.
